description: [Signal Desk] fAlpha's current model reading on one ticker, computed by quantitative models from numerical market data (no language model sets the number): the equity indicator (EI, signed: positive leans long, negative leans short), the signal's risk-adjusted track record (the Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio and share of positive periods of the signal's past readings for this ticker, horizon and regime), and the driver carrying the reading, with the date the signal is for. For questions like 'what does the model say about NVDA'. Available without an account.

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol in fAlpha's covered universe, e.g. NVDA. falpha_screener_desk_coverage reports whether a symbol is covered.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: falpha_signal_desk_card
title: Signal card
